# IArkConfigProvider
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/IArkConfigProvider.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IArkAccessManaged](./i-ark-access-managed.md), [IArkConfigProviderErrors](../errors/i-ark-config-provider-errors.md), [IArkConfigProviderEvents](../events/i-ark-config-provider-events.md)

**Title:**
IArkConfigProvider

Interface for configuration of Ark contracts

Inherits from IArkAccessManaged for access control and IArkConfigProviderEvents for event definitions


## Functions
### getConfig

Retrieves the current fleet config


```solidity
function getConfig() external view returns (ArkConfig memory);
```

### registerFleetCommander

Registers the Fleet commander for the Ark

This function is used to register the Fleet commander for the Ark
it's called by the FleetCommander when ark is added to the fleet


```solidity
function registerFleetCommander() external;
```

### unregisterFleetCommander

Unregisters the Fleet commander for the Ark

This function is used to unregister the Fleet commander for the Ark
it's called by the FleetCommander when ark is removed from the fleet
all balance checks are done within the FleetCommander


```solidity
function unregisterFleetCommander() external;
```
